[EN] Have you come here to mock us?
[ES] ¿Has venido a burlarte de nosotros?

[EN] There's no work. We can't find work anywhere.
[ES] No hay trabajo. No podemos encontrar trabajo en ninguna parte.

[EN] Excuse me—I don't suppose you're hiring?
[ES] Disculpa, supongo que no estarás contratando, ¿verdad?

[EN] Shouldn't you be doing something?
[ES] ¿No deberías estar haciendo algo?
